Public-sector and institutional employment has remained significant, with large federal and regional facilities such as the IRS in Ogden employing thousands [d137209s13p0].
The presence of large business parks converted from former military facilities, such as Business Depot Ogden, shows industrial land-use shifts toward commercial and industrial redevelopment [d137209s13p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: What role does the county play in regional transportation, logistics, higher education, and technology innovation ecosystems?
sub_answers.text:
The county is part of a major technology and innovation cluster, Silicon Slopes, centered on Salt Lake City and Provo that draws talent from local universities and accessibility via Salt Lake City International Airport [d42443867s0p0].
Ogden functions as an economic hub for the northern part of the state and hosts large federal, state, and regional employers, contributing to regional employment and services [d137209s13p0].
Legacy Highway components run along the west sides of several counties, including Salt Lake County, to provide an alternate north–south transportation corridor, supporting regional transportation and logistics [d42723418s0p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: How have county-level economic development policies, incentives, and infrastructure investments affected regional growth?
sub_answers.text:
Conversion of former military facilities into business parks, such as Business Depot Ogden, demonstrates infrastructure investment that has supported regional commercial redevelopment [d137209s13p0].
Transportation infrastructure planning, such as the Legacy Highway corridor, is intended to provide alternate north–south capacity and thus to affect regional growth and logistics [d42723418s0p0].
Development of the Silicon Slopes technology cluster has been supported by a local talent pipeline from universities and airport proximity, contributing to employment and startup growth in the region [d42443867s0p0].

What governmental entities and administrative structures provide municipal and regional services within the county?
sub_answers.text: County governments provide countywide services such as elections, voter registration, law enforcement, jails, vital records, property records, tax collection, public health, and social services [d80722795s0p0].  County governments also serve as the local government for unincorporated areas and may contract to provide municipal services to incorporated cities [d80722795s0p0].  Special-purpose local governments and school districts provide one or more specific services with administrative and fiscal autonomy [d32021s11p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: How are transportation, water, and wastewater services planned, funded, and administered at the county and regional levels?
sub_answers.text: Major transportation corridors are planned as regional projects that cross multiple counties, as exemplified by the Legacy Highway program spanning several northern Utah counties [d42723418s0p0].  Water and wastewater services in metropolitan areas can be provided jointly by multiple councils and managed by a regional infrastructure asset management company [d33804s37p0].  Water and wastewater projects can be funded via public-private financing models or direct public financing, as illustrated by a Canadian example where a federal infrastructure bank proposed a debt financing package and the locality later chose self-financing [d59409209s9p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: What interlocal agreements, regional authorities, or councils of governments operate in the county and what are their statutory powers?
sub_answers.text: Special-purpose districts, authorities, boards, and commissions are authorized by state law to provide designated functions and have administrative and fiscal autonomy [d32021s11p0].  Regional councils of governments can operate as recognized planning regions and may serve as county equivalents for statistical and planning purposes [d427714s22p0].  Multiple city and regional councils can jointly supply and govern infrastructure services, such as the five councils cooperating to provide the three waters in the Wellington metropolitan area [d33804s37p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: How is land-use planning and zoning authority distributed between the county, cities, and metropolitan service districts?
sub_answers.text: Chartered municipalities often provide their own municipal services including zoning and land-use regulation [d80722795s0p0].  Some incorporated cities contract with the county to have the county provide municipal services instead of providing them directly [d82055s9p0].  Territorial authorities or unitary authorities administer local government areas and can hold combined powers for local services and planning [d40864525s4p0].

Strict zoning regulations enacted since the 1960s in San Francisco and Bay Area cities limit building height, density, and demolition and have suppressed new housing supply [d42825615s20p0].
Homeowners have successfully leveraged land-use policies to exclude newcomers, which has been cited as a factor driving gentrification and affordability divides [d42825615s20p0].
